title_sq: Ne Fresk, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Verande Me Pamje Te Lire !!!
description_sq: Ne Fresk, Prane Shkolles 17 Shkurti Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Verande Me Pamje Te Lire Dhe Hapesira Te Bollshme. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 118 m2, neto 90 m2, verande 20 m2 dhe hapesire e perbashket 18 m2. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e fundit te nje pallati 7-katesh dhe eshte i organizuar ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale, nje dhome per femije, nje tualet me dritare dhe veranda e cila eshte e aksesueshme nga te gjitha dhomat. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug-Perendim cka i mundeson ndricim natyral, diell dhe pamje fantastike nga Tirana. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron qetesi, ajer te paster dhe te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode. Cmimi i apartamentit eshte 14.700.000 leke te reja
title_en: In Freske, 2+1 Apartment For Sale With Veranda With Free View!!!
description_en: In Fresk, near the school, February 17, 2+1 apartment for sale with a veranda with a free view and ample space. The apartment has a total area of ​​118 m2, net 90 m2, veranda 20 m2 and common space 18 m2. The apartment is located on the top floor of a 7-story building and is organized in the living room together with the kitchen corner, a matrimonial bedroom, a children's room, a bathroom with a window and a veranda which is accessible from all the rooms. The orientation of the apartment is South-West, which allows natural light, sun and a fantastic view of Tirana. The area in which the apartment is located offers peace, clean air and all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. The price of the apartment is 14,700,000 new lek
